abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina and performs a forward kick.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact, both based on Xilonen's DEF.

abilities.name: Blade Roller
_curatorNotes: Blade Roller is the in-stance N replacement (4 kicks instead of 3 sword strikes), gated by nightsoulBlessing state (opened by the skill's opensState field). DEF-scaling Geo damage (UseDef + IgnoreInfusion in gcsim); modelled via infusion: "geo" — DEF scaling itself isn't expressed in our schema.
No chargeFrames: the description explicitly says 'unable to use Charged Attacks' while in Blade Roller mode.

abilities.name: Yohual's Scratch
abilities.caveat: Skill cooldown begins when the Nightsoul state ends (not at cast). Modelled as cooldownStartDelay=540 frames to align CD with the natural 9s stance end; pressing E during Nightsoul to exit early starts the in-game CD from that moment, which is not modelled.
_curatorNotes: Yohual's Scratch enters Nightsoul Blessing (Blade Roller mode). Pressing E again while in Nightsoul exits the state in 1 frame; the schema models this as a stance with terminatesOnSwap: false (Nightsoul persists across swap in-game until points drain or timer expires).

opensState: "nightsoulBlessing" — opens the named state alongside the default inStance for the 9s stance window. Conditions on the in-stance Blade Roller normal gate on nightsoulBlessing specifically (not the generic inStance), making the semantic crisp.

Duration 9s reflects the Nightsoul timer. Actual exit: timer hits 0, points drain to 0, or E is re-pressed. Resource drain (5 points/sec) and 45-point starting pool aren't modelled per the constitution (windows not gauges).

C1 extends the Nightsoul timer by 45% (9s → ~13s) and reduces consumption by 30%. Not authored as a durationModifier because the underlying mechanic is a draining gauge, not a fixed window — the visible window length doesn't change cleanly with C1.
abilities.description:
Let the rhythms of passion resound throughout the land! Xilonen switches to high-speed combat blading gear and rushes forward a certain distance before dealing Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG based on her DEF.
After using this, Xilonen will gain 45 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state. In this state, she will shift to the Blade Roller mode.

Source Samples
Xilonen has 3 Samplers with her that can generate different Soundscapes based on her other party members' Elemental Types, decreasing nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES while active.
The initial recorded Source Sample within each Sampler will be Geo, and for each party member who is Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro, 1 Geo Sample will change to that corresponding Element.
While Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Geo Source Sample she carries will always be active. After unlocking her Ascension Talent, "Netotiliztli's Echoes," Xilonen can trigger said Ascension Talent's effects to regenerate Nightsoul points for herself. When her Nightsoul points hit the maximum, she will consume all her Nightsoul points and activate the 3 Source Samples she has on hand for 15s.
When the Source Samples are active, nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES will decrease. Source Sample effects of the same Elemental Type cannot stack. Xilonen can trigger these effects even when off-field.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Xilonen
Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When these points are depleted or if used again, this Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. This state has the following traits:
·Switches to the Blade Roller mode, increasing Xilonen's Movement SPD and climbing speed, and she can perform high-speed leaps in Ocelot Form while climbing.
·Xilonen's Nightsoul's Blessing has the following restrictions: When in this state, Xilonen's Nightsoul points have a 9s time limit. After this limit passes, her Nightsoul points will immediately expire.

After Xilonen's Nightsoul points have expired while she is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will no longer be able to generate Nightsoul points via the Ascension Talent "Netotiliztli's Echoes."

abilities.name: Ocelotlicue Point!
_curatorNotes: Burst has two modes based on samplersConverted: <2 → 3 damage hits (initial at 96f, follow-ups at 128f and 164f); ≥2 → single damage hit + 8 healing pulses every 1.5s over ~12s. Mode depends on team composition (number of non-Geo party members) and isn't expressible as a condition.
Authored as instant because the heal/follow-up beats are queued events inside the cast, not a persistent active window. Heal pulses (DEF-scaled) and follow-up beats are not separately rendered.
abilities.description:
Activates the Phlogiston Stereo DJ Controller (Portable) at full power, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Xilonen's DEF.

Additionally, she will trigger the following effects based on her different Source Samples:
·If she has at least 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, Xilonen will play an Ebullient rhythm, healing nearby active characters at intervals based on her DEF.
·If she has fewer than 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, Xilonen will start up an Ardent rhythm, which will play two additional beats that deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on her DEF.

passives.name: Netotiliztli's Echoes
_curatorNotes: Two branches keyed on samplersConverted: <2 → +30% N/P DMG (Nightsoul-tagged only); ≥2 → 35 Nightsoul points on N/P hit (drives the Sampler activation loop). Neither is modelled — the first depends on team-comp count we can't assert, the second is internal resource flow.
passives.description:
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state:
·If Xilonen has at least 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, she gains 35 Nightsoul points when her Normal or Plunging Attacks hit opponents. Can be triggered once every 0.1s.
·If Xilonen has fewer than 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, her Normal and Plunging Attacks deal 30% increased DMG.

passives.name: Portable Armored Sheath
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Self-trigger Q-equivalent when Nightsoul max (every 14s) — not modelled (depends on Nightsoul resource); (2) +20% DEF for 15s when nearby teammate triggers a Nightsoul Burst — modelled as a manual buff above. The trigger is keyed on the OnNightsoulBurst event in gcsim; manual is the closest schema fit since there's no "on-teammate-nightsoul-max" trigger.
passives.description:
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when Xilonen's Nightsoul points reach the maximum, she will trigger an effect equal to that of her Nightsoul Burst. This effect can be triggered once every 14s.
Additionally, when nearby party members trigger a Nightsoul Burst, Xilonen's DEF is increased by 20% for 15s.

constellations.name: Sabbatical Phrase
_curatorNotes: Nightsoul timer +45% / consumption -30%. Not modelled as a durationModifier on the skill stance because the underlying mechanic is a draining resource pool — the visible 9s window doesn't expand by a clean ratio. Per-constitution (windows not gauges), this stays as description-only.
constellations.description:
Xilonen's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30%, and her Nightsoul point time limit is extended by 45%.
Additionally, when Xilonen's Source Samples are active, she can also increase nearby active characters' interruption resistance.

constellations.name: Chiucue Mix
_curatorNotes: Per-element team buffs (Geo +50% allDmgBonus, Pyro +45% atk%, Hydro +45% hp%, Cryo +60% critDmg, Electro +25 energy / -6s burst CD), 15s window after Sampler activation. Not modelled — each buff applies only to teammates of matching element, and our schema can't gate on teammate element. Authoring as target: "team" would over-buff non-matching members; authoring as target: "self" misrepresents the mechanic. Skip until a per-element-target gating primitive exists.
constellations.description:
Xilonen's Geo Source Samples will always remain active. Additionally, when her Source Samples activate, all nearby party members will gain effects corresponding to the active Source Sample that matches their Elemental Type:
·Geo: DMG dealt +50%.
·Pyro: ATK +45%.
·Hydro: Max HP +45%.
·Cryo: CRIT DMG +60%.
·Electro: Restore 25 Energy, decrease Elemental Burst CD by 6s.

constellations.name: Tonalpohualli's Loop
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yohual's Scratch by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Suchitl's Trance
_curatorNotes: Blooming Blessing: +65% Xilonen DEF as flat damage on N/C/P, max 6 procs / 15s. Modelled as an unlimited 15s buff on N/C/P flat damage; the 6-proc cap and the per-character independent counter aren't gateable in the current schema. Removed prior placeholder damage effect (was authored as enemy-targeted damage instead of team flat-dmg buff).
constellations.description:
After Xilonen uses Yohual's Scratch, she will grant all nearby party members the Blooming Blessing effect for 15s.
Characters with Blooming Blessing deal 65% of Xilonen's DEF as increased Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG. This effect will be removed after triggering 6 times or when the duration ends.
When you hit more than one opponent, trigger counts will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit. The counts for each party member with Blooming Blessing are counted independently.

constellations.name: Tlaltecuhtli's Crossfade
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ocelotlicue Point! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Imperishable Night Carnival
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +300% DEF flat damage on Nightsoul-aligned N/P for 5s (15s ICD), triggered by sprint/leap/N/P during Nightsoul; (2) heal pulses every 1.5s × 3 ticks, 120% DEF. Not modelled — the trigger is the union of multiple action types during a state, and the 5s window pauses the Nightsoul timer (a feature the schema can't express). Removed prior placeholder damage and heal effects.
constellations.description:
When Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when she sprints, leaps, or uses Normal or Plunging Attacks, she will gain Imperishable Night's Blessing, ignoring the limitations of her Nightsoul's Blessing state and increasing the DMG dealt by her Normal and Plunging Attacks for 5s.
During this time:
·Her Nightsoul's Blessing time limit countdown will be paused. Xilonen's Nightsoul points, Phlogiston, and Stamina will not decrease, and when her Nightsoul points reach the maximum, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end either.
·Xilonen deals 300% of her DEF as increased Normal and Plunging Attack DMG while in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
·She heals nearby party members for 120% of her DEF every 1.5s.
She can gain 1 Imperishable Night's Blessing once every 15s.
